items.source: Disables the default exposure of repositories entirely. I.e. repositories to be exported must now be explicitly annotated with RepositoryRestResource and methods need to be annotated with RestResource to trigger exposure of default resources. Basically a shortcut for calling both setRepositoryDetectionStrategy(RepositoryDetectionStrategy) to RepositoryDetectionStrategy.RepositoryDetectionStrategies.ANNOTATED and setting setExposeRepositoryMethodsByDefault(boolean) to false.
items.translation: 完全禁用存储库的默认暴露。即，现在必须显式使用 RepositoryRestResource 注解要导出的存储库，并使用 RestResource 注解方法来触发默认资源的暴露。这基本上等同于调用 setRepositoryDetectionStrategy(RepositoryDetectionStrategy) 将其设置为 RepositoryDetectionStrategy.RepositoryDetectionStrategies.ANNOTATED，并将 setExposeRepositoryMethodsByDefault(boolean) 设置为 false。

items.source: Sets whether to expose repository methods by default. If this is disabled, CRUD methods must be annotated with RestResource explicitly to expose the default set of resources (opt-in). If this is set to true (default), repository methods are exposed unless explictly annotated with RestResource and RestResource.exported() set to false.
items.translation: 设置是否默认暴露仓库方法。如果禁用此选项，则 CRUD 方法必须显式标注 RestResource 才能暴露默认的资源集（即采用“选择加入”模式）。如果将此值设置为 true（默认值），则会暴露仓库方法，除非这些方法显式标注了 RestResource 并将 RestResource.exported() 设置为 false。
